nodes.description: Private owner address of ZoomiesToken; privileged address used by every require(msg.sender == owner) gate.
Public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) holding token balances; mutated with raw -= / += arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance(address=>address=>uint) of spending approvals; written by approve and mutated in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting sales per address, incremented on every transferFrom and read by condition().
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist consulted by ensure(); bypasses sale limits.
Private minimum sale amount, set only by init(), checked in condition().
Private maximum sale amount, set only by init(), checked in condition().
Private per-address sale count limit, set only by init(), checked in condition().
Address exempted from sale checks, settable by owner through setTradeAddress().
Public total token supply, minted entirely to msg.sender in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address 0x7a25...488D that is decalred in the second UNI storage slot and hard-coded in ensure().
Constant public decimals = 18, used in scaling arithmetic in init() and the constructor.
Public token name string set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set once in the constructor.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that unconditionally forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist gate: allows owner, tradeAddress, canSale addresses and hard-coded/derived Uniswap pair addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) that spends allowance, calls ensure(), and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints against _onSaleNum[_from] and _value.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-controlled address a with attacker-controlled calldata b.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked multiplication scaling by 10**decimals.
Owner-only mass transfer looping over _tos and computing total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap CREATE2 pair-address derivation using keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender, setting owner and granting unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance spending and as the source of transfers.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary external code in the storage context of ZoomiesToken.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend that can overflow and under-state the required balance.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath), can underflow below the balanceOf check ordering assumption.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath), allows balance overflow.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init().
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom after the >= check.
